reviewStandard: Five routes fail duplicate-identity, phenotype, isoform-and-residue, or stereochemical-and-causal evidence gates and receive no marked prompt or generation call. Taurine alone is cleared for one immutable, heavy-atom-connectivity-only generation call.
promotionRule: Only a literal Taurine output with exactly seven visible heavy-atom centers and the frozen two-carbon, one-nitrogen, one-sulfur, three-oxygen connectivity may proceed to exact-hash review. The other five routes remain non-public scientific holds.
